view{padding-top:132px;background:rgba(7,11,16,.96)}
.thumb-grid{max-width:1360px;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:12px}
.thumb{border-radius:6px;border:1px solid #dce1e6;min-height:100px;box-shadow:none}
.thumb:hover{border-color:#579ce0}

/* typography and spacing refinements */
.label{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.15em;margin-bottom:17px}
h2{font-size:54px;line-height:1.13}
p{font-size:21px;line-height:1.67}
.action-title p{margin-top:15px}
.bottom-message{left:88px;right:88px;bottom:42px;padding-top:15px;font-size:22px}
.footnote{left:88px;right:88px;bottom:22px}
.three-flat,.timeline-flat,.option-table,.quality-grid,.team-table,.business-list,.closing-list,.warranty-flat,.record-flat{border-color:#cfd5db}
.compare-pane,.safety-box,.portrait-flat{border-color:#cfd5db}
.tag-list span,.compact-flow span{border-color:#cfd5db}

@media(max-width:900px){
  .deck-nav{padding-left:8px;padding-right:8px}.nav-label{font-size:9px}.nav-num{font-size:12px}
  .status-section{display:none}.thumb-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
}

/* v4: all presentation navigation moved to the bottom */
.slide-inner{padding:70px 88px 162px}
.cover .slide-inner,.qa .slide-inner{padding:0 0 110px}
.cover-layout,.qa-flat{height:100%}

.deck-chrome{top:auto!important;bottom:0;height:110px;border-bottom:0;border-top:1px solid #222932;box-shadow:0 -3px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.14)}
.deck-nav{height:74px;padding:8px 14px 0}
.deck-status{height:36px}
.progress{top:auto!important;bottom:108px!important;height:2px}

/* keep slide-level captions clear of the persistent bottom UI */
.bottom-message{bottom:148px}
.footnote{bottom:126px}

/* controls live in the status row */
.status-right{gap:8px}
.chrome-btn{height:26px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;white-space:nowrap}
.chrome-btn.utility{color:#87929e}
.chrome-btn.step{min-width:74px;border:1px solid #34404c;background:#141b23;color:#cbd5df;font-size:12px;padding:4px 11px}
.chrome-btn.step:hover{border-color:#528bc5;background:#172536;color:#fff}
.chrome-btn.step.next{border-color:#346fa8;background:#123155;color:#eef7ff}
.chrome-btn.step.next:hover{background:#174372;border-color:#5ba5e8}
.chrome-btn:disabled{opacity:.28;cursor:default;background:transparent!important;border-color:#2b333c!important;color:#68727c!important}

.notes{top:22px;right:18px;max-height:calc(100% - 154px)}
.overview{padding:48px 48px 132px;background:rgba(7,11,16,.96)}

@media(max-width:900px){
  .slide-inner{padding-bottom:162px}
  .status-title,.status-label,.status-value,.status-sep{display:none}
  .chrome-btn.step{min-width:58px}
}
